entities.name: Sergėjus Jovaiša
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sergejus Jovaiša is a Lithuanian former professional basketball player. He played at the shooting guard position and won the bronze medal with Lithuania national team at the 1992 Summer Olympics. He was also a member of the Soviet national team that won the bronze medal at the 1980 Summer Olympics.
